chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Streaming chat with any loaded model. Conversations stay in this browser.
chat.emptyHint: Pick a model, type a message and press Enter. Shift+Enter starts a new line.
chat.noModelsHint: The server lists no models. Check the Models screen.
chat.toolReplyHint: The model called a tool. Enter what it returned and send it back to continue.
chat.session: Session {{id}} — reused for the prompt cache
chat.optionsHint: Kept in this browser and applied to every message. Empty fields use the model's recommended values.
chat.dialectHint: The same server through either API. Native keeps session_id and device; OpenAI is what other clients use.
chat.stopHint: One per line; \n stands for a newline.
chat.cachePromptHint: Off forces a full prefill, to measure it.
chat.toolsHint: A JSON array of {name, description, parameters}; the OpenAI {type, function} form works too.

models.title: Models
models.description: The catalog, what is on disk and what is loaded. Managing models needs an admin key.
models.emptyHint: The catalog is empty in this build.
models.reloadHint: Hot swap: load afresh, move new requests over, let running ones finish on the old copy
models.actionFailed: The action did not go through
models.confirmUnloadBody: Requests already running finish first. The next request loads it again.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Backends and devices the server detected, their memory and the models resident on each.
devices.emptyHint: No backend could be opened. Check backends.enabled and lib_dir.
devices.notVerified: none yet — this device is offered with fallback

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Batch generation: a JSONL file of chat requests, run in the background.
jobs.submitHint: One chat request per line, as POST /api/v1/chat takes it.
jobs.requestsHint: Paste lines or load a file.
jobs.defaultModel: Each line's model, or the default
jobs.emptyHint: Jobs you enqueue appear here with their progress.
jobs.notYet: The job queue is not in this build yet
jobs.notYetHint: The server answers 501 for /api/v1/jobs: the queue lands later in v1.0. This screen will work as soon as it does.

bench.title: Bench
bench.description: Measure the presets that fit this machine on the reference prompts. Results stay here unless you submit them.
bench.runHint: Each preset runs in its own process: load, pp512, tg128 at two depths, and a chat through the whole pipeline.
bench.standardHint: Fixed prompts and parameters; comparable across machines.
bench.privacy: Nothing leaves the machine without your confirmation.
bench.notYet: Benchmarks are not available in this build yet
bench.notYetHint: The server does not offer /api/v1/bench yet. The screen is ready for when it does.
bench.consentText: Submitting sends exactly the JSON below to the public benchmark at nano.llmto.day: the reference metrics and a coarse hardware profile — no hostname, user name, serial numbers or MAC addresses. You can withdraw it later with the installation key.
bench.anonymousHint: A one-time key: the submission cannot be linked to this installation, nor withdrawn.
bench.declined: Not submitted. The result is still here to save.
bench.submitNotYet: Submission is not available in this build yet
bench.devNotSubmitted: dev suite results are for local comparison and are never submitted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Interface, API key and the server's effective configuration.
settings.apiKeyHint: Kept in this browser and sent only to this server. Leave empty if the server runs without authentication.
settings.apiKeyRequiredHint: API requests are refused without one. Enter it to carry on.
settings.configHint: Read-only, secrets redacted. Change it in the configuration file or the NANOLLM_* environment.
settings.configForbidden: The configuration needs an administrative key
settings.historyHint: Conversations are stored only in this browser.
